title: Check the script before the film
statement: Check a media script before the media is made, because fixing content after recording means a costly re-record.
detail: A pre-generation evaluator was added for the scripts of short instructional videos, on the reasoning that catching factual, structural and one-idea-per-script problems before the video is generated avoids costly re-records (git commit df5aa18 in `shadow/bench`, lines 3-5). It judges nine dimensions, four of them critical (lines 7-10). The saving is reasoned, not measured.
